Urquhart – Toolebeck 115kV line: Rebuild
Project ID
6852
Project Description
Upgrade the 477 ACSR portions of the Urquhart – Toolebeck 115 kV line to 1272 ACSR. Replace existing structures with Single Pole Double Circuit Structures. Approximately 12.5 miles.
Project Need
This project is needed to improve system performance and to meet NERC TPL and internal DESC Planning Criteria for reliability.

In Progress
